meta.method: EXACT brute-force cosine at both dimensions — no ANN, no Qdrant scoring, no RRF/dedup/MMR. The MRL lane's output is the exact 64d top-N; the candidate set passed to fusion is the exact full-dim top-L within it.
meta.unit: fraction of a query's REACHABLE labelled pages present in the candidate set
meta.what: the OUTER full-dim re-score cut: how deep must the ranking go before the fusion lane stops losing reachable labelled pages?
